correctness: Pilot each frozen script once before timing. Require exit0, empty stderr, finite NDJSON, exact rows, successful workload-specific events and expected warning IDs. Keep first refusals as workload-admission failures. Freeze full canonical output digest after admitted pilot; every timed run must match it exactly. Canonicalization sorts object keys only, retains array order and numeric JSON values; raw output hashes are also retained. This does not inspect state hidden by the public JSON interface.
timing: Blocking process wait with group watchdog. One serial worker. GNUtime wall/user/sys/maxRSS plus high-resolution parent wall. Two warmup fresh-process runs and eight timed fresh-process repetitions per workload. Report median/min/max/MAD; do not call fresh-process warmups warm in-process engine execution. Separate solver/serialization attribution; no speedup claim before candidate paired comparison. High-resolution wait4 user/system/maxRSS also include time wrapper and waited descendants; GNU CPU clocks remain coarse.
candidate_comparison: ABBA/BAAB alternating own exact-source release baseline/candidate, at least eight timed samples each. Bit-identical outputs. Allocation/call-count attribution separately; report uncertainty and outliers, no significance claim from medians alone.

cases.scope: Fresh process includes startup and JSON serialization; repeated commands have within-process solver/cache reuse. No numerical chemistry forecast.
